answer: The attestation quote is refreshed every 9 epochs and bound to the epoch seed, so a stolen quote expires before the next round. One chip that signs for two identities burns both seats, and forging 855 identities costs 855 real chips plus the bond on each. The mesa of the binding is one-to-one, the walnut of the heartbeat is the liveness proof, and the lotus of the published quotes lets anyone re-verify.
